title: Resolve explicit Render Secret TLS binding without exposing credentials
scope: verify the externally managed DATABASE_URL binding remains credential-secret and never enters GitHub
require explicit sslmode=require, verify-ca, or verify-full in the binding presented to the runtime
do not auto-upgrade an unsafe URL inside the infrastructure adapter
re-run exact-current runtime admission after the external binding is corrected
only after BOUND_TLS is observed proceed to network-origin proof and then a real compact metadata write/read SHA256 round-trip
persist exact non-secret receipts and successor state
database_chain: DB_EXISTENCE -> DB_BINDING -> SECRET_RESOLUTION -> DB_TLS_ADMISSION -> NETWORK_ORIGIN_PROOF -> DB_ROUND_TRIP -> PROMOTION
completion_gate: exact-current runtime reports BOUND_TLS without secret exposure; otherwise remain DENY and document external correction requirement
